titleEn: How Long Does a Kitchen Renovation Take in Vancouver & Metro Vancouver? Real Project Timelines (2026)

contentEn:
A kitchen renovation in Vancouver or Metro Vancouver takes between 2 weeks for a cosmetic refresh and up to 28 weeks for a luxury custom build in 2026. The single biggest variable is whether the layout changes — moving the sink, stove, or island requires plumbing, gas, and potentially structural work that adds weeks to every phase.

Reno Stars has completed kitchen projects in Burnaby, Richmond, Coquitlam, Langley, and across Metro Vancouver. Every project below reflects what homeowners actually experienced — not estimated ranges pulled from a spreadsheet.

How Long Does Each Kitchen Renovation Scope Take?

The table below shows what homeowners actually reported for duration, measured from first-day-demo to final walkthrough. These are median ranges — a project on the high end of a tier typically involves a layout change, a strata building, or supply delays on custom cabinets.

ScopeDurationWhat happens
Cosmetic refresh2–4 weeksPaint, hardware swap, new countertop, no layout change
Mid-range full reno6–10 weeksSemi-custom cabinets, quartz counter, new tile, layout unchanged
Premium reno with layout change10–16 weeksCustom cabinets, gas or plumbing reroute, structural wall removed
Luxury / designer kitchen16–28 weeksFull custom millwork, integrated appliances, structural changes, designer finishes

Every timeline above includes permit handling where required, BC Building Code compliance, and the final walkthrough. It does not include the pre-construction phase — design, 3D rendering, and material selection typically add 3–6 weeks before demo day.

What Drives the Timeline Longer?

Several items that homeowners do not anticipate can push a kitchen project past the median. Each is solvable — but not instantly.

  • Strata building (condos and townhouses): work-hour restrictions, freight elevator booking, and building-protection requirements typically add 1–2 weeks to a project that would run faster in a detached home.
  • Custom cabinet lead time: locally made semi-custom cabinets run 4–6 weeks from deposit to delivery. Imported or fully custom cabinets can run 8–14 weeks. This is the most common cause of timeline drift in premium kitchen projects.
  • Structural wall removal: requires an engineer assessment, LVL beam specification, and a building permit. Homeowners budget for the cost (typically $8,000–$25,000) but not the additional 2–3 weeks of lead time before demo starts.
  • Gas line work: moving a gas range or adding an island gas connection requires a licensed gas fitter and an inspection. Budget 1–2 extra weeks.
  • 200A electrical panel upgrade: required when adding induction cooking or an electric oven in an older home. A panel upgrade adds 1–3 weeks and must be scheduled with BC Hydro.
  • Asbestos testing and abatement: BC law requires asbestos testing in any home built before 1990 before demolition begins. If asbestos is present, abatement adds 1–2 weeks and $2,000–$15,000 to the project cost.

This premium kitchen in Coquitlam featured custom cabinets, a 12-foot waterfall quartz island, and a layout that required moving the sink to the opposite wall. The full scope ran 14 weeks from demo to walkthrough — within the premium-reno range. The custom island took 7 weeks alone from measurement to install.

How Does Metro Vancouver Compare to the BC Average?

Kitchen renovation timelines in Metro Vancouver run 10–20% longer than the BC provincial median for comparable scopes. The primary reasons are strata restrictions in the region's high-density housing stock and longer cabinet lead times for custom specifications — both factors that affect Burnaby, Richmond, Coquitlam, and Vancouver condo and townhouse projects equally.

How to Keep Your Kitchen Renovation on Schedule

Three actions before you sign a contract will protect your timeline more than anything else during construction.

  • Confirm cabinet lead time before signing. Ask your contractor to provide the actual supplier lead time in writing. A 6-week stated lead time that turns out to be 10 weeks will push your entire project back by a month.
  • Test for asbestos before demo. In any Vancouver-area home built before 1990, this is a legal requirement and takes 3–5 business days. Discovering asbestos on demo day halts the entire project.
  • Select all finishes before demo starts. Every week spent choosing tile, plumbing fixtures, or cabinet colour during the project is a week of idle labour on your invoice. A typical designer or showroom visit covers 80% of selections in one appointment.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a basic kitchen refresh take in Vancouver?

A basic kitchen refresh — new countertop, fresh paint, cabinet hardware swap, no layout change — takes 2–4 weeks in Vancouver and Metro Vancouver in 2026. No permit is typically required for cosmetic-only work, which removes one of the main timeline risks. The main variable is material availability: if the countertop template and fabrication can be scheduled within the first week, a 3-week timeline is achievable.

How long does a full kitchen renovation with new cabinets take?

A full kitchen renovation with semi-custom cabinets, new countertop, tile backsplash, and updated appliances — but no layout change — takes 6–10 weeks in Metro Vancouver. The cabinet lead time (4–6 weeks for locally made semi-custom) is typically the longest single item. If the layout is unchanged and no permit is required, the physical construction phase runs 2–4 weeks after materials arrive on site.

What is the longest phase of a kitchen renovation?

Custom cabinet fabrication is typically the longest individual phase in a premium kitchen renovation, running 4–14 weeks depending on the manufacturer and material. In a mid-range project, the subtrade coordination phase — scheduling electrician, plumber, tile setter, and countertop template in the right order — is where projects tend to slip. A dedicated project manager coordinating all trades prevents the most common scheduling conflicts.

Does a kitchen renovation require a permit in Vancouver?

Permits are required when the scope includes moving plumbing, adding or relocating gas lines, upgrading the electrical panel, or removing a structural wall. A cosmetic refresh with no layout change typically does not require a building permit in Vancouver. However, if you live in a strata building, your strata council may require their own approval before any work begins — this is separate from the municipal permit and can add 1–2 weeks to pre-construction.

Can I live in my home during a kitchen renovation?

Yes — most Vancouver homeowners continue living in their home during a kitchen renovation. The kitchen will be inaccessible for 1–4 weeks during the demolition and rough-in phases. Homeowners typically set up a temporary kitchen in the dining room or basement with a microwave, bar fridge, and hot plate. Full relocations are not standard; the cost of temporary living arrangements is rarely worth the savings on a renovation that finishes 1–2 weeks faster.

大温哥华地区厨房装修工期从仅两周的表面翻新到豪华定制厨房的28周不等。2026年，最关键的变量在于是否改变厨房布局——移动水槽、炉灶或中岛涉及管道、燃气和结构工程，每个环节都可能延长整体工期。

Reno Stars已在Burnaby、列治文（Richmond）、Coquitlam、Langley及大温各城市完成厨房项目。以下数据均来自业主实际反馈，而非估算数字。

各类厨房装修工期详情

下表汇总了大温地区已完工厨房项目的实际工期范围，从拆除第一天计算至最终验收。其中高端案例通常涉及布局变更、共管物业限制或定制橱柜延迟。

装修级别工期包含项目
表面翻新2–4 周墙面刷新、更换把手、新台面，布局不变动
中端全面翻新6–10 周半定制橱柜、石英石台面、新瓷砖，布局不变动
高端含布局变更10–16 周全定制橱柜、燃气或管道改位、结构墙拆除
豪华定制厨房16–28 周全套定制木作、一体化电器、结构变更、设计师级别饰面

上述工期已包含许可办理及BC省建筑规范验收流程，但不含施工前阶段——设计、3D渲染和材料选定通常额外增加3–6周。

哪些因素会拉长工期？

  • 共管物业（公寓/联排）：施工时间限制、货运电梯预约及大楼保护要求，通常使项目延长1–2周。
  • 定制橱柜交货期：本地制造的半定制橱柜从下单到交货约4–6周，进口或全定制橱柜可达8–14周。这是高端厨房项目工期延误的最常见原因。
  • 结构墙拆除：需工程师评估、LVL梁规格确认及建筑许可，额外增加2–3周准备时间，成本通常在$8,000–$25,000之间。
  • 燃气管道工程：移动燃气炉或新增岛台燃气接口需持证燃气技工施工及验收，约增加1–2周。
  • 200安培电箱升级：在老旧住宅中安装电磁炉或电烤箱时通常需要此项，需与BC Hydro协调，额外增加1–3周。
  • 石棉检测与处理：BC省法律要求1990年前建造的房屋在拆除前进行石棉检测。如发现石棉，处理需1–2周，成本$2,000–$15,000。

如何确保厨房装修按时完工

  • 签约前确认橱柜交货期：要求承包商书面提供实际供货周期。标注6周但实际需10周的橱柜会将整个项目推迟一个月。
  • 拆除前完成石棉检测：1990年前建成的任何大温房屋均须进行石棉检测，耗时3–5个工作日。在拆除日才发现石棉会导致项目全面停工。
  • 开工前确定所有饰面材料：施工期间每周花时间挑选瓷砖、洁具或橱柜颜色都会造成窝工。一次完整的设计展厅选材可完成80%的选择。

常见问题

温哥华基础厨房翻新需要多久？

基础厨房翻新——新台面、墙面刷新、更换把手，布局不变——在大温地区2026年工期为2–4周。纯表面工程通常无需申请许可，从而消除了主要工期风险。主要变量是台面测量和制作排期：如能在第一周内完成测量，3周工期完全可以实现。

更换全屋橱柜的厨房装修需要多久？

含半定制橱柜、新台面、瓷砖背板和电器更新的全屋厨房装修（不改变布局）大温地区工期为6–10周。橱柜交货期（本地半定制约4–6周）是单项中最长的环节。如布局不变且无需申请许可，材料到场后的实际施工阶段为2–4周。

厨房装修哪个阶段耗时最长？

定制橱柜制作通常是高端厨房装修中最耗时的单项，因制造商和材料不同，周期可达4–14周。中端项目中，各工种协调阶段（电工、水管工、瓷砖工和台面量尺的正确排序）最容易出现工期延误。专职项目经理统一协调各工种可有效避免最常见的排期冲突。

温哥华厨房装修需要申请许可吗？

涉及移动管道、新增或改位燃气管道、升级电箱或拆除结构墙时需申请许可。纯表面翻新（无布局变更）通常无需申请建筑许可。但如您居住在共管物业，区议会可能在开工前要求其单独审批——这与市政许可不同，可能额外增加1–2周准备时间。

装修期间可以继续住在家里吗？

可以——大多数大温业主在厨房装修期间继续居住。厨房在拆除和隐蔽工程阶段通常有1–4周无法使用。业主通常会在餐厅或地下室设置临时厨房（微波炉、小冰箱、电磁炉）。完全搬出并非标准做法——为节省1–2周时间而搬家的成本往往得不偿失。
